entries.summary: On a host, run session claim from the host root after docs/active_state.json exists; session_start --boot resolves repo_root to .agents and must not be treated as the host Zero Coordinate.
Cursor PreToolUse hooks must emit {"permission":"allow|deny"} on stdout; wrap on_commit.py so its prose goes to stderr.
Do not seal an Accepted structure ADR or execute layout changes until the human has debated product shape in chat; a premature ADR must be reverted and the plan returned to DRAFT.
Casual OK is not Approval Gate while the human is still clarifying product intent; keep IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN in DRAFT and stay in chat until they ask to redact the project plan.
